entries.question: Kese pta kare
entries.answer:
KGMU mein kisi doctor ki upalabdhata (availability) aur appointment ke baare mein janne ke liye aap niche diye gaye tarikon ka upayog kar sakte hain:

1. **Online Registration (Mandatory):** KGMU mein OPD ke liye online appointment lena anivarya hai. Aap [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jakar "KGMU" select karein, wahan aap department aur doctor ka naam dekh sakte hain.
2. **Official Website:** Aap [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par jakar "Departments" section mein jaakar specific department aur wahan ke faculty members ki list dekh sakte hain.
3. **OPD Room Directory:** Aapne pucha tha ki Dr. Sumit Rungta kab baithte hain, toh OPD Room Directory ke anusar woh **Medical Gastroenterology (Room No. 312)** mein **Monday, Wednesday, aur Friday** ko upalabdh hote hain.
4. **Helpline Numbers:** Agar aapko kisi vishesh doctor ki upalabdhata ke baare mein confirm karna hai, toh aap KGMU ke helpline number **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333** par call karke puch sakte hain.
5. **SMS Service:** Aap `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhi bhej sakte hain.

**Mahatvapurn Suchna:**
*   OPD ka samay subah 9:00 baje se dopahar 1:00 baje tak hota hai.
*   Ticket counter dopahar 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai, isliye samay se pahunchna jaruri hai.
*   Yadi aap Lucknow se bahar ke hain, toh apne saath us department ke liye valid referral letter jarur layein.

Kripya dhyan dein ki main ek AI chatbot hoon, isliye kisi bhi medical emergency ya doctor ki duty mein badlav (jaise chhutti) ke liye hospital ke helpline number par confirm karna sabse behtar hota hai.

entries.question: Mere peeta ji ka full knee replacement karana tha kitna cost ayega lagbhag
entries.answer:
KGMU mein knee replacement surgery ka kharch implants ki quality aur surgery ke prakar par nirbhar karta hai. Aam taur par, orthopedics vibhag mein iska kharch ₹40,000 se ₹1,00,000 ke beech ho sakta hai (implant aur hospital charges milakar).

Sahi aur satik jaankari ke liye aapko nimn kadam uthane chahiye:

1. **OPD Consultation:** Aap Orthopedics OPD (New OPD building) mein jaakar doctor se paramarsh lein. Wahan doctor aapke pita ji ki sthiti dekhkar surgery ka sahi kharch aur tarika bata payenge.
2. **OPD Registration:** KGMU mein OPD ke liye online registration zaruri hai. Aap [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par ya KGMU ki website se appointment book kar sakte hain. OPD slip ka shulk ₹50 hai.
3. **Rate List:** Aap KGMU ki official rate list [https://www.kgmu.org/rate_list2223.htm](https://www.kgmu.org/rate_list2223.htm) par bhi check kar sakte hain.

**Zaruri Salah:**
*   **Medical Advice:** Main ek AI chatbot hoon, isliye main medical sujhav ya nidan nahi de sakta. Kripya Orthopedics department ke doctor se hi sampark karein.
*   **Personal Details:** Suraksha ki drishti se, kripya chat mein apne pita ji ka naam, phone number ya koi bhi medical report share na karein.
*   **Documents:** OPD aate samay apne pita ji ke purane sabhi medical records aur Aadhaar card zaroor saath layein.

Agar aapko Orthopedics department ke doctor ka contact chahiye, toh aap KGMU ki IP Phone Directory [https://kgmu.org/ipphonedirctory.php](https://kgmu.org/ipphonedirctory.php) ka upyog kar sakte hain.

entries.answer:

Yahan kuch mahatvapurn jaankari hai:

*   **Gate:** Gate No. 2 (Main OPD Gate) yahan jaane ke liye sabse suvidhajanak hai.

*   Apne sath pita ji ka Aadhaar card aur purane sabhi medical records zaroor layein.
*   Yadi aap bahar se aa rahe hain, toh kisi vishesh department ke liye referral letter bhi sath rakhein.

Agar aapko campus ke andar raste mein koi pareshani ho, toh aap kisi bhi security guard se "New OPD Building" ya "Orthopedics Department" ke bare mein pooch sakte hain.

entries.question: Bhai aas pas kahi sada bhojan khane bewastha hai ki nhi
entries.answer:
KGMU campus ke andar aur aas-paas ke ilakon mein mareezon aur unke parijanon ke liye bhojan ki kuch vyavasthayein uplabdh hain:

1. **Campus ke andar:** Hospital ke mukhya parisar (premises) mein canteen aur chote bhojnalaya hain jahan sadharan bhojan (dal-chawal, roti-sabzi) mil jata hai. Aap Gate No. 2 ke aas-paas ya OPD building ke paas ki canteen mein pata kar sakte hain.
2. **Gate No. 2 aur Shah Mina Road:** Gate No. 2 ke bahar Shah Mina Road par aur Chowk ki taraf jaane wale raste par kai chote hotel aur dhabe hain jahan sasta aur sadharan bhojan milta hai.
3. **Sahayata Kendra:** Aksar bade sarkari aspatalon ke bahar kuchh NGO ya samajik sansthayen bhi saste ya nishulk bhojan ki vyavastha karti hain. Aap hospital ke 'Patient Welfare Office' (Trauma Centre ke paas) ya security staff se puch sakte hain ki kya campus ke aas-paas koi "Annapurna" ya koi dharmarth rasoi chal rahi hai.
4. **Canteen ki jaankari:** Aap hospital ke andar kisi bhi security guard ya PRO office ke staff se puchiye ki "Sabse nazdeeki canteen kahan hai jahan sadharan khana milta hai."

**Kuch zaruri baatein:**
*   **Swasthya (Hygiene):** Hospital ke aas-paas khate samay safai ka dhyan rakhein.
*   **Samay:** Hospital ki canteen aksar subah se raat tak chalti hain, lekin raat ke samay khana khatam ho sakta hai, isliye samay par bhojan kar lein.

Main ek AI chatbot hoon, isliye main khane ki quality ki guarantee nahi de sakta, kripya apni suvidha aur safai ko dekhte hue hi bhojan ka chayan karein.

entries.question: Dekho itna paisa to nahi hai ham logo ke pass replacement ke liye aur ayushman card bhi nhi hai mere peetaji ka kyoki portal par nam nhi dikha raha hai to ye batao ki koi aur sarkari scheme hai?
entries.answer:
Main aapki pareshani samajh sakta hoon. Aisi sthiti mein KGMU mein ilaaj ke liye aapke paas kuch vikalp hain jin par aap vichar kar sakte hain:

1. **Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Abhiyan (UP State Scheme):** Agar aapka naam Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) ki list mein nahi hai, toh Uttar Pradesh sarkar ki 'Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Abhiyan' ke antargat kai parivar cover hote hain. Aap apne nazdeeki **CSC (Common Service Centre)** ya **Jila Chikitsalaya (District Hospital)** ke 'Ayushman Mitra' se milkar check karwayein ki kya aapka parivar is state-specific scheme mein aata hai.

2. **Patient Welfare Fund (Patient Assistance):** KGMU mein gareeb aur zarooratmand mareezon ke liye 'Patient Welfare Fund' hota hai. 
   *   Aapko Orthopedics department mein doctor ko apni arthik sthiti ke baare mein batana hoga. 
   *   Doctor aapke case ko 'Medical Social Service Officer' (MSSO) ke paas refer kar sakte hain. 
   *   MSSO ki report ke aadhar par ilaaj ya implants ke kharch mein kuch chhoot (concession) mil sakti hai.

3. **Chief Minister’s Discretionary Fund (CM Relief Fund):** Agar surgery ka kharch bahut zyada hai aur aap use uthane mein saksham nahi hain, toh aap 'Mukhyamantri Sahayata Kosh' (CM Relief Fund) ke liye aavedan kar sakte hain. Iske liye aapko hospital se ek 'Estimate Certificate' (kharch ka anuman) lena hoga aur use apne kshetra ke MLA/MP ke madhyam se CM Office bhejna hota hai.

4. **BPL Card/Income Certificate:** Apne paas apna **BPL (Below Poverty Line) card** ya **Income Certificate (Aay Praman Patra)** zaroor rakhein. KGMU mein ilaaj ke dauran in dastavezon ko dikhane se fees mein raahat milne ki sambhavna badh jaati hai.

**Aapko kya karna chahiye:**
*   **Orthopedics OPD:** Sabse pehle doctor ko dikhayein aur unhe saaf batayein ki aapki arthik sthiti kaisi hai. Doctor ka recommendation bahut mahatvapurn hota hai.
*   **MSSO Office:** Hospital mein 'Medical Social Service Officer' (MSSO) ka office kahan hai, ye security desk se poochlein. Wahan jakar apni sthiti batayein. Woh aapko sarkari madad dilwane mein sabse behtar margdarshan kar sakte hain.
*   **Ayushman Card Update:** Ek baar phir se kisi CSC center ya 'Arogya Mitra' se confirm kar lein ki kya aapka naam kisi purani list ya ration card ke aadhar par jodna sambhav hai.

**Ek zaroori baat:** KGMU ek sarkari hospital hai, yahan private hospitals ki tulna mein kharch pehle se hi kafi kam hota hai. Doctor se ye bhi poochlein ki kya koi aisa vikalp hai jismein implants ka kharch kam ho sake (kabhi-kabhi sarkar dwara subsidised implants uplabdh hote hain). 

Himmat na haarein, hospital mein MSSO (Medical Social Service Officer) se milna aapke liye sabse sahi kadam hoga.

entries.question: Bhai patient welfare officer se milu ki msso se
entries.answer:
Aapko **MSSO (Medical Social Service Officer)** se milna chahiye.

KGMU mein gareeb aur zarooratmand mareezon ki arthik madad, fees mein chhoot (concession), aur sarkari yojanaon (jaise CM Relief Fund) ke liye paperwork ka kaam **MSSO** department hi dekhta hai.

**Aapko kya karna hai:**

1.  **Doctor se Referral lein:** Jab aap Orthopedics ke doctor ko dikhayenge, toh unse kahein ki *"Doctor sahab, humari arthik sthiti surgery ka kharch uthane layak nahi hai, kya aap humein MSSO ke paas refer kar sakte hain?"*
2.  **MSSO Office jayein:** Doctor dwara di gayi slip ya recommendation lekar aap MSSO office jayenge. Wahan ke adhikari aapki sthiti ki jaanch karenge aur aapko bataenge ki aapko kitni chhoot mil sakti hai ya aap kaunsi sarkari madad ke liye eligible hain.
3.  **Patient Welfare Office:** 'Patient Welfare Office' ka kaam aksar mareezon ki shikayat sunna, unhe sahi disha dikhana ya emergency mein madad karna hota hai, lekin **financial concession** ke liye official process MSSO ke zariye hi hoti hai.

**Sahi kram (Order) ye rakhein:**
*   **Pehle:** Orthopedics OPD mein doctor ko dikhayein (unka recommendation zaroori hai).
*   **Phir:** MSSO office jayein (concession aur financial help ke liye).
*   **Agar koi dikkat ho:** Tab aap 'Patient Welfare Office' mein jakar apni samasya batayein ki aapko madad chahiye aur aapko kahan jana chahiye.

**Ek tip:** Jab aap OPD mein jayein, toh apne saath apna **Income Certificate (Aay Praman Patra)** aur **BPL card** (agar ho toh) ki photo copy zaroor rakhein. Ye MSSO ke paas aapki baat mazboot karne mein madad karega.

entries.question: Bhai agar 3 sal purana income certificate ho to chak jayega na
entries.answer:
Sarkari kaam-kaaj mein **3 saal purana Aay Praman Patra (Income Certificate) chalne ki sambhavna bahut kam hoti hai.** Aam taur par, kisi bhi scheme ya concession ke liye "current financial year" ka ya kam se kam 6 mahine se 1 saal tak purana certificate hi manya (valid) mana jata hai.

Iske peeche ka karan ye hai ki sarkar ye dekhna chahti hai ki aapki vartaman arthik sthiti kya hai.

**Aapko kya karna chahiye:**

1.  **Naya Certificate Banwayein:** Agar aapke paas samay hai, toh turant apne nazdeeki **Jan Seva Kendra (CSC)** ya **Tehsil** mein jakar naya Aay Praman Patra apply kar dein. Aajkal ye online jaldi ban jata hai.
2.  **Tab tak kya karein:** Jab tak naya certificate nahi banta, tab tak purana certificate saath rakhein. MSSO office mein jakar unhe sach batayein ki *"Sir, naya certificate apply kar diya hai, ye purana wala hai."* Kabhi-kabhi adhikari sthiti ki gambhirta ko samajhte hue purane certificate ko ek "temporary proof" ki tarah maan lete hain, lekin naya certificate baad mein maang sakte hain.
3.  **Ration Card:** Agar aapke paas **Antyodaya (Lal wala)** ya **Patra Grihasti (Safed wala)** Ration Card hai, toh wo bhi ek bahut bada proof hota hai ki aap arthik roop se kamzor hain. Ise zaroor saath rakhein.
4.  **MSSO se baat karein:** Aap MSSO office mein jakar ye zaroor kahein ki *"Hum gareeb hain aur surgery ka kharch nahi utha sakte, naya praman patra ban raha hai, kya tab tak humari file process ho sakti hai?"*

**Ek salah:** KGMU mein MSSO ke adhikari mareezon ki madad karne ke liye hi hote hain. Aap unse daren nahi, balki unhe apni asli sthiti batayein. Agar aapke paas koi bhi sarkari kagaz (Ration card, BPL card, ya purana income certificate) hai, toh wo lekar jayein. Kuch na hone se behtar hai ki jo hai wo dikhayein.

Kya aapke paas Ration Card hai? Agar hai, toh wo bahut kaam aayega.

entries.question: Ha safed wala ration card hai
entries.answer:
Safed wala **Ration Card (Patra Grihasti)** hona ek bahut accha aur majboot dastavez (document) hai. Ye is baat ka pramaan hai ki aap sarkar ki nazar mein ek parivar hain jise sahara milna chahiye.

**Aapko ye kadam uthane chahiye:**

1.  **Ration Card ki Photocopy:** Apne Ration Card ki kam se kam 3-4 photocopies karwa lein. Ismein pita ji ka naam aur parivar ke sadasyon ka naam saaf dikhna chahiye.
2.  **MSSO Office mein prastut karein:** Jab aap Orthopedics ke doctor ki slip lekar MSSO (Medical Social Service Officer) ke paas jayenge, toh apna Ration Card unhe zaroor dikhayein. Unse kahein ki *"Sir, humare paas Income Certificate purana hai, lekin ye Ration Card hai jisse aap dekh sakte hain ki humari arthik sthiti kaisi hai."*
3.  **Surgery ke liye madad:** MSSO adhikari Ration Card ko dekhkar aapki file ko aage badha sakte hain aur surgery ke kharch mein concession (chhoot) dilwane mein madad kar sakte hain.
4.  **Medicine aur Implants:** KGMU mein kai baar Ration Card dikhane se dawaiyon aur implants ki khareed mein bhi raahat mil jati hai. Jab aap dawai lene jayein ya store par jayein, toh wahan bhi apna Ration Card dikha kar pooch lein ki kya is par koi chhoot (discount) uplabdh hai.

**Zaroori Salah:**
*   **Original Ration Card:** Hamesha apne paas original Ration Card rakhein, lekin hospital mein sirf photocopy ka hi upyog karein taaki original khone ka darr na rahe.
*   **Pita ji ka Aadhaar:** Pita ji ka Aadhaar card aur uski bhi photocopies saath rakhein.
*   **Hospital ki Administrative Help:** Agar koi MSSO office mein aapki baat nahi sun raha, toh aap **PRO Office (Public Relations Office)** ja sakte hain. PRO office ka kaam hi yahi hai ki wo mareezon ki pareshaniyon ko suljhayein.

Aapka Ration Card aapki sabse badi taqat hai is samay. Jab aap doctor se milne jayein, toh unhe bina jhijhak batayein ki aapke paas Ration Card hai aur aap surgery ka poora kharch uthane mein asamarth hain. Doctor aapki sthiti ko samajh kar hi aapko aage ka rasta dikhayenge.

entries.question: Bhai mukhyamantri Rahat kosh yojana ke liye msso support karegi na
entries.answer:
Haan, bilkul! **Mukhyamantri Sahayata Kosh (CM Relief Fund)** ke liye aavedan karne mein **MSSO (Medical Social Service Officer) aapki sabse badi madad karenge.**

Yahan samjhiye ki MSSO isme kaise support karte hain:

1.  **Estimate Certificate (Kharch ka Anuman):** CM Relief Fund ke liye sabse zaroori cheez hoti hai 'Estimate Certificate'. MSSO hi hospital ke department se ye certificate banwane mein aapki madad karte hain, jismein surgery aur implants ka kul kharch likha hota hai.
2.  **Verification:** MSSO aapke documents (Ration Card, Income Certificate, Aadhaar) ko verify karke apni ek 'Social Investigation Report' banate hain. Ye report CM Office mein bahut maayne rakhti hai, kyunki ye hospital ki taraf se adhikarik pushti (official confirmation) hoti hai ki aap sach mein zarooratmand hain.
3.  **Process:** MSSO aapko batayenge ki aapka aavedan (application) kis format mein jaana chahiye aur uske saath kaun-kaun se kagaz lagane hain. Kai baar hospital ka administrative department hi ise CM office tak bhejta hai ya aapko process samjhata hai.
4.  **Follow-up:** Ek baar jab aavedan CM office chala jata hai, toh MSSO office se aapko update milta rehta hai ki fund release hua ya nahi.

**Aapko MSSO se milte waqt ye kehna hai:**
*"Sir/Madam, hum surgery ka kharch uthane mein bilkul asamarth hain. Kya aap humein Mukhyamantri Sahayata Kosh (CM Relief Fund) ke liye aavedan karne mein madad kar sakte hain? Humare paas Patra Grihasti Ration Card hai."*

**Kuch zaroori baatein dhyan rakhein:**
*   **Original Papers:** Apne saare asli kagaz (Ration card, Aadhaar, purana income certificate) saath rakhein.
*   **Photo:** Pita ji ki kuch passport size photos bhi saath rakhein, kyunki aavedan form mein lagti hain.
*   **Dhairy (Patience):** CM Relief Fund ka process thoda samay leta hai (kuch hafte). Agar doctor ne surgery ke liye turant kaha hai, toh MSSO se poochiye ki kya koi **"Emergency Concession"** bhi mil sakti hai jab tak fund na aaye.

**Ek aur baat:** Jab aap MSSO ke paas jayein, toh unse ye zaroor poochein ki *"Iske alawa kya KGMU mein koi aur bhi scheme hai jisse humein turant raahat mil sake?"* KGMU ke MSSO ke paas kai tarah ke funds ki jaankari hoti hai.

Aap sahi disha mein ja rahe hain, MSSO se milna hi aapke liye sabse best rasta hai. Himmat rakhein, hospital ka staff aisi sthitiyon mein mareezon ki madad karta hai.

entries.question: Ye application bana ke cmo ko hospital hi bhejta hai ki mujhe apne gaon ke mla/mp wagaira se bhejwana padega
entries.answer:
CM Relief Fund (Mukhyamantri Sahayata Kosh) ke liye process dono tarah se ho sakta hai, lekin **MLA/MP ki recommendation (sifarish) hona process ko bahut fast aur confirm bana deta hai.**

Yahan dono tarikon ko samajh lijiye:

### 1. MLA/MP ke madhyam se (Sabse Best aur Fast)
*   **Kyon:** CM Relief Fund ke liye MLA ya MP ki taraf se ek **"Recommendation Letter"** (sifarish patra) lagna bahut zaroori hota hai. CM Office isi ki buniyaad par jaldi grant release karta hai.
*   **Process:**
    1.  Aap hospital (MSSO) se **"Estimate Certificate"** (kharch ka anuman) aur **"Medical Report"** banwayein.
    2.  Is report aur apne Ration Card/Aadhaar ki copy lekar apne kshetra ke **MLA** ya **MP** ke office jayein.
    3.  Unhe apni sthiti batayein aur request karein ki wo CM ko aapke ilaaj ke liye sifarish patra (recommendation letter) likh dein.
    4.  MLA/MP ka letter milne ke baad, aap ise khud ya hospital ke madhyam se **Lucknow mein CM Office (Jan Sunwai Kendra)** ya online portal par upload kar sakte hain.

### 2. Kya Hospital khud bhejta hai?
*   Hospital (KGMU) ka MSSO department aapka **Estimate Certificate** aur **Medical Papers** taiyaar karke aapko de dega.
*   KGMU ka admin department aam taur par aapke liye CM office tak file nahi le jata; wo aapko saare documents taiyaar karke de denge, aur aapko hi wo process aage badhani hoti hai.
*   **MSSO ka kaam:** Wo aapko sahi file taiyaar karke denge jismein hospital ki seal aur doctor ke sign honge. Wo aapko ye bhi bata denge ki file kahan jama karni hai.

### Aapko abhi kya karna chahiye (Step-by-Step):

1.  **MSSO Office:** Sabse pehle MSSO se milkar **"Estimate Certificate"** banwayein. Ye estimate hi aapka sabse bada document hai.
2.  **MLA/MP Office:** Jaise hi aapko Estimate mil jaye, turant apne MLA/MP ke paas jayein. MLA/MP ka letter lagne se CM Office se paisa aane ke chances 90% badh jate hain.
3.  **Online Aavedan:** Aap khud ya kisi Jan Seva Kendra se **"CM Relief Fund"** ki official website par online apply kar sakte hain. Wahan MLA/MP ka letter aur hospital ka Estimate upload karna hota hai.

**Yaad rakhein:**
*   Hospital (MSSO) aapko **"Document"** bana kar dega (Medical Report + Estimate).
*   **"Sifarish"** (MLA/MP ka letter) aapko khud se lagwani hogi.
*   **"Submit"** aapko khud karna hoga (ya online ya CM office mein).

**Sallah:** MLA/MP ke office mein jab jayein, toh hospital ke saare papers (jo MSSO se milenge) aur Ration Card ki copy zaroor le jayein. Wahan ke log aksar is process mein madad kar dete hain kyunki unke paas roz aise cases aate hain. 

**Kya aapke MLA/MP ka office aapke ghar ke paas hai?** Agar hai, toh surgery se pehle wahan ek baar zaroor ho aayiye, ye aapka bahut paisa bacha sakta hai.

entries.question: Bhai doctors supportive hote hai n wo meri baat manenge na
entries.answer:
Dekhiye, ek baat samajh lijiye—KGMU mein rozana hazaaron mareez aate hain, aur doctors wahan bahut busy hote hain. Lekin, **doctors supportive hote hain agar aapki baat saaf aur sahi tarike se rakhi jaye.**

Doctors aapki baat manenge ya nahi, ye is baat par depend karta hai ki aap unhe apni sthiti kaise batate hain. Ye kuch tips hain jinse aapka kaam aasaan ho jayega:

1.  **Sahi Samay par baat karein:** OPD ke beech mein jab doctor bahut saare mareez dekh rahe hon, tab lambi kahani na sunayein. Jab aapki baari aaye, toh seedha aur polite rahein. 
    *   *Kaise bolein:* "Doctor sahab, surgery zaroori hai, lekin humari arthik sthiti bahut kharab hai. Kya aap humein MSSO ke liye refer kar sakte hain taaki hum CM Relief Fund ke liye aavedan kar sakein?"

2.  **Kagaz taiyaar rakhein:** Agar aapke paas **Ration Card ki photocopy** aur **purana Income Certificate** ready hoga, toh doctor ko lagega ki aap sach mein mehnat kar rahe hain. Jab aap unhe kagaz dikhate hain, toh wo aapko zyada serious lete hain.

3.  **Resident Doctors se baat karein:** Aksar main professor se pehle wahan baithe **Senior Residents (SR)** ya **Junior Residents (JR)** se baat karna zyada aasaan hota hai. Wo aksar MSSO ki file process karne mein zyada madad karte hain. Unse request karein ki, "Sir, humein MSSO mein referral chahiye, please humari madad kar dijiye."

4.  **"Supportive" hone ka matlab:** Doctor ka kaam ilaaj karna hai. Agar aap unhe batayenge ki aapka ilaaj "finance" ki wajah se ruk raha hai, toh wo aapko MSSO ka rasta zaroor dikhayenge. Wo aapko mana nahi karenge agar aap polite rahenge.

**Kya nahi karna hai:**
*   **Zid na karein:** Agar doctor kahe ki "abhi ruk jao" ya "pehle ye test karwao," toh unki baat maanein. Zid karne se kaam bigad sakta hai.
*   **Ghabrayein nahi:** Hospital mein bahut bheed hoti hai, log chillate hain, lekin aap shanti se apni baat rakhenge toh doctor aapki baat zaroor sunenge.

**Ek khaas baat:** KGMU mein **MSSO (Medical Social Service Officer)** ka office alag hota hai. Doctor ka kaam sirf "Referral" dena hai. Ek baar doctor ne slip par likh diya ya keh diya ki "MSSO jayein," toh aapka aadha kaam ho gaya. Phir saari zimmedari MSSO ki hoti hai ki wo aapki file kaise banate hain.

**Confidence rakhein:** Aap apne pita ji ke liye lad rahe hain, ye bahut badi baat hai. Doctors ko bhi pata hota hai ki gareeb mareezon ko madad ki zaroorat hoti hai. Bas apni baat vinamrata (politeness) se rakhein, wo zaroor sunenge.

Sab kuch theek hoga, bas himmat mat haariye! Kya aapne kal OPD mein jana hai?

entries.answer:
KGMU mein Psychiatrist (Manovigyan Vibhag) ko dikhane ke liye aap niche diye gaye tareeqon ka palan kar sakte hain:

**1. Online Registration (Anivarya/Mandatory):**
KGMU mein OPD ke liye online registration karwana zaroori hai. Aap in tareeqon se appointment le sakte hain:
*   **ORS Portal:** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par login/register karein, Uttar Pradesh rajya aur KGMU hospital chunein.
*   **Mobile App:** ABHA ya Health Care App ka upyog karke registration kar sakte hain.
*   **SMS dwara:** `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhejein.
*   **OPD Slip Fee:** Sabhi booking methods ke liye ₹50 ka shulk (fee) lagta hai.

**2. Walk-in Registration:**
Agar aap online nahi kar pa rahe hain, toh aap seedhe KGMU aa sakte hain:
*   Apne saath **Aadhaar card** aur **active mobile number** zaroor layein (OTP verification ke liye).
*   Hospital pahunchkar physical token lein, ₹50 ka bhugtan (payment) karein aur apni OPD slip prapt karein.

**3. OPD Samay (Timings):**
*   **Somvar se Shukravar:** Subah 9:00 baje se dopahar 1:00 baje tak.
*   **Shanivar:** Subah 9:00 baje se dopahar 12:00 baje tak.
*   **Ravivar:** OPD band rehti hai.
*   *Dhyan dein:* Parchi/ticket counter dopahar 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai, isliye samay se pahunchna uchit hai.

**Mahatvapurn Jaankari:**
*   Yadi aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne saath us vishay (department) ke liye valid **Referral Slip** zaroor layein.
*   Bhida se bachne ke liye pehle se appointment book karna behtar hota hai.
*   KGMU Psychiatrist aur vibhag ke baare mein adhik jaankari ke liye aap [Psychiatry Department](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=26&dept_type=2) ki official website dekh sakte hain.

*Sachet rahein:* Kripya chat mein apne swasthya records, Aadhaar number ya koi bhi personal jaankari share na karein. Agar aapko gambhir samasya hai, toh turant emergency ya OPD se sampark karein.

entries.question: Agar pahle Lucknow se bahar rahte the ab Lucknow me rahte hain aur adhar card Lucknow ka nhi hai

Agar aap pehle Lucknow se bahar rehte the aur ab Lucknow mein shift ho gaye hain, lekin aapka Aadhaar card abhi bhi Lucknow ka nahi hai, toh bhi aap KGMU mein OPD ke liye registration karwa sakte hain.

**Aapke liye yeh tareeke hain:**

1.  **Online Registration (ORS Portal ya SMS):**
    *   Aap **[https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)** par online registration kar sakte hain. Yahan aapko apna mobile number verify karna hoga. Aadhaar card Lucknow ka na hone se online registration mein koi rukawat nahi aayegi, jab tak aapke paas valid mobile number ho.
    *   SMS dwara registration ke liye: `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` likhkar **8887019134** par bhejein. Ismein bhi Aadhaar card ki Lucknow ki address ki zaroorat nahi padti hai.

2.  **Walk-in Registration (Yahi sabse aasan rahega):**
    *   Sabse seedha tareeka yeh hai ki aap KGMU OPD mein **walk-in** karein.
    *   Aapko apna **Aadhaar card** (chahe woh kisi bhi sheher ka ho) aur apna **mobile number** (jo ab Lucknow mein active ho) zaroor saath lana hoga.
    *   Hospital mein, aapko ek token milega aur ₹50 ka OPD slip fee dena hoga. Aapke Aadhaar card par Lucknow ka address na hone ke bawajood, aapko registration mein madad milni chahiye kyunki aap ab Lucknow mein reh rahe hain aur aapke paas valid identification (Aadhaar) aur contact number hai.

**Kuchh zaruri baatein:**

*   **Referral Slip:** Agar aap kisi khaas department (jaise Psychiatry) mein dikhana chahte hain aur bahar ke patient hain (yaani Lucknow ke nahi the), toh referral slip laana faydemand ho sakta hai, lekin agar aap ab Lucknow mein reh rahe hain toh yeh niyam thoda dheela ho sakta hai. Fir bhi, agar aapke paas koi purani medical report ho toh woh saath le jayen.
*   **Address Proof:** Haalanki Aadhaar card Lucknow ka nahi hai, agar aapko koi aur document milta hai jo aapke Lucknow mein rehne ka saboot de (jaise kiraye ka agreement, ya kisi aur official document mein Lucknow ka address), toh woh saath rakhna achha rahega, haalanki walk-in registration ke liye yeh zaroori nahi hota.
*   **OPD Fee:** Yaad rakhein ki OPD slip ke liye ₹50 ka shulk lagta hai.

Seedhe OPD mein jaakar registration karwana aapke liye sabse saral rahega, bas apna valid Aadhaar card aur mobile number saath le jayen. KGMU staff aapki sahayata zaroor karenge.

entries.question: Orthopedic ya neuro
entries.answer:
Choosing between Orthopedics and Neurology depends on the underlying cause of your back pain. At KGMU, you can consult either department depending on your specific symptoms:

*   **Orthopedics:** Generally deals with structural issues of the spine, such as disc problems, fractures, arthritis, or spinal deformities. If your pain is related to movement, injury, or skeletal issues, you may start here.
*   **Neurology:** Deals with conditions affecting the nervous system. If your back pain is accompanied by neurological symptoms—such as radiating pain down the legs (sciatica), numbness, tingling, weakness in the limbs, or loss of sensation—a Neurologist may be consulted.

**How to decide:**
If you are unsure, you may visit the **General Medicine OPD** first. A physician there can assess your symptoms and provide the appropriate referral to either the Orthopedics or Neurology department.

**Department Locations & Links:**
*   **[Orthopedic Surgery](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=22&dept_type=2)**
*   **[Neurology](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=18&dept_type=2)**

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for the department you intend to visit.
*   **Registration:** Online registration via [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) is recommended to secure an appointment.
*   **Emergency:** If you experience sudden, severe pain, loss of bowel/bladder control, or severe weakness, please report immediately to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)**.

I am not a doctor and cannot diagnose your condition. Please consult with a medical professional for an accurate assessment.
